Renewal IncreaseLeased rents below the unit's market rent, with leases ending soon · click a row to see those leases, then a resident for their details

Source: Entrata Rent Roll as of 10/21/2026 (unit status, rents, residents) and Market Rent Schedule as of 10/8/2026 (base rent and premiums) · Base = the floor plan's most common base rent · Premium = unit amenity rent · Exposure = vacant-unrented + notice-unrented ÷ units · New leases = move-ins in the last 90 days (adjustable in Recommendation settings) · New lease avg = average leased rent of those move-ins · Rent-capped = affordability tiers (%) and Westwood Village housing limits · Days vacant from the Entrata Availability report (pre-leased units are not on it)

Needs Follow-UpItems that affect the accuracy of this report
    Bill Back vs. Cost by Property

    Recovery % = resident billings ÷ property expense, net dollars under each % · red = collecting less than we pay, green = more · water is billed at a 95% cap, so about 95% is on target · trash = city trash only (valet trash expense has no postings May – Aug 2026) · pest cost = Pest Control + Pest Control Contract

    Residents Paying Each FeeUnits charged = August 2026 income ÷ monthly rate (approximate, due to prorations and credits) · RP deposit premium has two tiers ($28 / $36), shown as a range · click a column to sort
    Month-to-Month AuditExpiring leases report 9/21/2026 · every month-to-month unit should carry the MTM fee and a rent at or above the last renewal
    Units to CorrectMissing the fee, no rent increase, or a site note · in 34 of 39 charged units the scheduled charges equal Market Rent, so the fee may sit inside that figure — worth a spot check in Entrata
    Washer / Dryer Connections and MachinesAs reported by each site · units without machines can't be counted until each site provides a connection count

Month (4110) · Net rental income = Rental Income section + Vacancy, Concessions & Collection Losses section · Phantom income = Charges to Tenants for Damage (4313) and Lease Termination (4315, plus 4339 Termination Fees at Churchill) · Costs to cover = Total OpEx + Debt Service (interest, principal, rate cap) + Non-Operating + Fixed Assets; depreciation and acquisition costs excluded · Breakeven econ. occupancy = costs ÷ GPR · Required econ. occupancy = breakeven − other income (excl. phantom) as % of GPR
